title: All field strengths are possible locally in Boozer coordinates
summary: The magnetic field strength is a central design object in the theory of magnetic confinement of plasma. Desirable confinement properties such as quasi-symmetry and omnigenity are characterized by special forms of the field strength when it is given in the particular coordinate system called ``Boozer coordinates." We ask a basic realizability question: which functions of Boozer coordinates can arise as the magnitude of a magnetic field that is written in Boozer coordinates?
